intact.what_it_is: Open, literature-curated molecular interaction database hosted at EMBL-EBI; the shared curation platform of the IMEx consortium.

mint.what_it_is: Literature-curated protein interactions from the University of Rome Tor Vergata; curated within IntAct (IMEx member).

imex.what_it_is: Consortium of interaction databases (IntAct, MINT, DIP, …) sharing one curation standard; records curated to IMEx rules.

mpidb.what_it_is: Curated microbial protein interactions; the original site is offline and its data lives on in IntAct.

dip.what_it_is: Experimentally determined protein interactions curated at UCLA (IMEx member).

matrixdb.what_it_is: Interactions involving extracellular-matrix proteins, proteoglycans and polysaccharides (University of Lyon).

innatedb.what_it_is: Curated interactions and pathways of the innate immune response.

hpidb.what_it_is: Curated interactions between host and pathogen proteins (Mississippi State University).

uniprot.what_it_is: Interactions annotated by UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot curators and deposited via IntAct.

bhf-ucl.description: British Heart Foundation – University College London
bhf-ucl.what_it_is: Cardiovascular gene-annotation team at UCL that curates interactions of cardiovascular-relevant proteins into IntAct.

biogrid.description: Biological General Repository for Interaction Datasets
biogrid.what_it_is: Literature-curated protein and genetic interactions across major model organisms and human.

i2d.what_it_is: Known and predicted protein interactions collected by the Jurisica lab, University of Toronto.

homomint.what_it_is: Human interactions inferred from orthologous interactions in model organisms, derived from MINT.

hprd.what_it_is: Manually curated human protein interactions; no longer updated.

interpro.what_it_is: Protein families, domains and functional sites (EMBL-EBI).

omim.what_it_is: Catalogue of human genes and genetic disorders.

molecular connections.what_it_is: Commercial curation team (Bangalore, India) that curates interaction data into IntAct.

proteomexchange.what_it_is: Consortium coordinating public mass-spectrometry proteomics repositories.

pmc.what_it_is: Free full-text archive of biomedical literature.

flybase.what_it_is: Drosophila genetics and genomics database; contributes curated interaction records via IntAct.

empiar.what_it_is: Archive of raw electron-microscopy image data.

go.what_it_is: Gene-function annotation resource; interaction records originating from GO curation.

wwpdb.what_it_is: Consortium maintaining the single global PDB archive.

mbinfo.what_it_is: Curation team of the MechanoBiology Institute, National University of Singapore, contributing mechanobiology-related interactions to IntAct.

ntnu.description: Norwegian University of Science and Technology
ntnu.what_it_is: Curation team at NTNU (Trondheim) contributing interactions to IntAct.

bmrb.what_it_is: Archive of NMR spectroscopy data on biomolecules.
